thought.text: All static export pages serve correctly. Now let me clean up the temporary servers I started:

reasoning_content: All the HTML files in the static export are being served correctly. Everything looks good. Alright, let's clean up — stop the dev server and the static server (these are the ones I started, and they're fine to stop since they're not part of the installation). Let me kill them cleanly.

action.command: pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "/tmp/serve.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':3000|:8080' || echo "ports 3000 and 8080 released"; rm -f /tmp/serve.js /tmp/dev.log /tmp/static.log /tmp/page.html /tmp/sp.html

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "pkill -f \"next dev\" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f \"/tmp/serve.js\" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':3000|:8080' || echo \"ports 3000 and 8080 released\"; rm -f /tmp/serve.js /tmp/dev.log /tmp/static.log /tmp/page.html /tmp/sp.html", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Stop dev and static servers, clean up"}

summary: Stop dev and static servers, clean up
